sentence_stem: Had the committee been informed earlier,
correct_completion: the project would have been saved.
full_sentence: Had the committee been informed earlier, the project would have been saved.

options.text: the project would be saved now.
options.why_wrong: The time reference does not match the past condition 'had been informed', which points to a past result.
'So' introduces a real consequence, not a hypothetical result of an unrealised past condition.

options.text: the project would have been saved.
the project will have been saved.
options.why_wrong: 'Will have been' refers to a future completion and does not match the hypothetical past condition.

explanation: In an inverted third conditional, 'had' at the start replaces 'if', and the main clause uses 'would have' with a past participle. Learners whose first language has no direct equivalent of this inversion often drop the perfect form, so the main clause needs the full 'would have' structure.
translation: Si el comité hubiera sido informado antes, el proyecto se habría salvado.
